item.title: Microsoft to Disclose Azure Sales After Years of Investor Gripes
item.description: Microsoft Corp. will begin disclosing quarterly sales for its Azure cloud unit, reversing course after years of criticism from Wall Street regarding a lack of information about the company’s most important growth engine.

item.title: Snowflake Jumps on Revenue Outlook, Uptake of AI Assistant
item.description: Snowflake Inc. gained in extended trading after the company raised its outlook for annual sales, topping analysts’ estimates, and touted rapid adoption of its AI-assisted coding tool.

item.title: Broadcom Forecast Disappoints Investors After Nvidia Blowout
item.description: Broadcom Inc. gave a fourth-quarter forecast that missed analysts’ estimates, a sign it’s getting a slower payoff from the AI boom than some anticipated.

item.title: Lutnick Says Anthropic Has Patched Relations With US Government
item.description: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said that Anthropic PBC has patched its relationship with the Trump administration, signaling a possible end to months of sharp differences over security between the US and the artificial intelligence developer.

item.title: HPE Lifts Sales Forecast on AI Demand for Servers, Networking
item.description: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. boosted its sales outlook for this fiscal year and next, saying artificial intelligence workloads are driving demand for servers and networking gear.

item.title: Elliott Builds Deutsche Telekom Stake, Opposes T-Mobile Merger
item.description: Elliott Investment Management has built a sizeable stake in Deutsche Telekom AG and indicated the German telecommunications giant should ditch a potential merger with its American arm T-Mobile US Inc., people familiar with the matter said.

item.title: Meta Releases More Powerful AI Model, Edging Closer to Rivals
item.description: Meta Platforms Inc. released its most powerful artificial intelligence model yet, with its chief AI officer saying its capabilities are edging closer to top competitors.

item.title: JPMorgan’s Blessing Sees Dealmaking on Track for Record Year
item.description: A surge of mergers and public offerings in the final months of 2026 could push dealmaking volumes to a new high, despite growing concerns over the economy, according to Dorothee Blessing, co-head of global investment banking at JPMorgan Chase & Co.

item.title: Bessent Blasts US Hyperscalers for Failure to Tout AI Benefits
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent blasted the US companies ramping up investment in artificial intelligence, faulting them for failing to build ties with communities amid a wave of popular concern over data centers boosting the cost of living.

item.title: Israel Leans On Galilee as Marine Bacterium Limits Desalination
item.description: A marine bacterium which disrupted Israel’s desalination plants has prompted the government to increase freshwater pumping from the Sea of Galilee and aquifers.

item.title: Fed’s Beige Book Shows Economic Activity Up Modestly
item.description: US economic activity increased modestly in the past two months with demand from data centers, in particular, driving growth, the Federal Reserve said.

item.title: Two Sigma’s Overdeck Says Control of Firm a Concern in Divorce
item.description: Two Sigma Investments co-founder John Overdeck testified in his divorce trial that maintaining equal control of the quantitative hedge fund with co-founder David Siegel is a “principal concern” for him in any division of marital assets.

item.title: Apple: CEO John Ternus recibirá US$58 millones en 2027, Cook US$47 millones
item.description: Cook deja el cargo de CEO tras 15 años al frente de Apple.

item.title: Waymo Taps Pimco, Blackstone for $3 Billion in First Debt Deal
item.description: Waymo is in the final stages of talks to raise debt for the first time, tapping lenders including Pacific Investment Management Co. for more than $3 billion as it looks to become the leading robotaxi company globally.

item.title: Amazon, Walmart Face Data Requests in DOJ Beef Antitrust Probe
item.description: The US Justice Department expanded its antitrust inquiry of the meatpacking industry by demanding information on surging beef prices from eight major food retailers, including Amazon.com Inc., Costco Wholesale Corp. and Walmart Inc.

item.title: Kalshi Seeks Never-Expiring Oil Futures Amid 24/7 Trading Debate
item.description: Kalshi Inc. will seek regulatory approval for an oil-linked futures contract that never expires, a move that would bring a product popular in crypto markets into the traditional energy sphere as the industry debates the risks of round-the-clock markets.

item.title: Napster Shifts Course to Penny-a-Minute AI Agents Via Microsoft
item.description: Napster, the former music-streaming platform, is betting on low-cost AI agents as its path back to success.

item.title: UVA’s Situational Awareness Bet Fueled Record Year Before Tumult
item.description: When AI-focused hedge fund Situational Awareness lost more than two-thirds of its $45 billion in July, most of the investors who took the hit were wealthy individuals and tech founders.

item.title: Iran-linked Hackers Hit 100 American Water Utilities
item.description: EPA giving away $11 million to boost water systems cybersecurity

item.title: Uber’s $15 Billion Delivery Hero Takeover Gains Board Backing
item.description: Delivery Hero SE’s board voted to accept a takeover offer from Uber Technologies Inc., moving the nearly $15 billion deal for the German delivery platform another step toward completion.

item.title: NYSE Used Anthropic’s Project Glasswing to Find Cyber Flaws
item.description: The New York Stock Exchange used Anthropic PBC’s Project Glasswing to find and fix vulnerabilities in its cyber security systems, its president, Lynn Martin, told Congress.

item.title: Fed Watchdog Flags Questions Around Confidential Information
item.description: The Federal Reserve’s internal watchdog said the central bank should do more to prevent the sharing of confidential nonpublic information with its 12 regional reserve bank boards, which include private-sector bankers and business leaders.

item.title: US Lawmakers Pass Africa Trade Preference Extension to 2028
item.description: US lawmakers agreed to extend a trade preference program with African nations until the end of 2028.

item.title: Circle K Owner Says Inflation, Fuel Costs Curb Consumer Spending
item.description: Convenience and gas station retailer Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc. reported record fuel sales as oil prices soared amid the Middle East conflict, but consumers are also tightening their budgets and visiting stores less often. Shares dropped the most in more than five months.

item.title: Fashion Empire Azzas 2154 to Split Two Years After Failed Merger
item.description: Azzas 2154 SA, one of Brazil’s largest apparel exporters, will split into two independent publicly traded companies as its main shareholders seek to end a months-long dispute over governance and strategy.

item.title: Uber to Exit Nigeria, Uganda as Part of Global Restructure
item.description: US ride-hailing giant Uber Technologies Inc. is shutting down its services in Nigeria and Uganda from September 2, following a global review of its operations.

item.title: Senegal’s Bond Selloff Reveals Investor Angst on Debt Rework
item.description: Investors who had been holding out hope that Senegal could avoid a default are changing tack, selling its short-dated bonds as they expect losses ahead.

item.title: Danish Central Bank Intervenes Again to Defend Currency Peg
item.description: Denmark’s central bank intervened to support a weakening krone for the second time since June, underscoring the persistent pressure on the currency that could herald an interest-rate hike.

item.title: Spyware Targeted Serbian Protest Organizers’ Phones, Report Says
item.description: Spyware targeted Serbian student activists and politicians involved in anti-corruption protests against President Aleksandar Vucic ahead of local elections in March, a new report claimed.

item.title: The ‘Permission Bottleneck’ Coming for Stocks
item.description: The AI buildout has been lifting all boats.
